faq.question: Q1. When is the walk-in interview for VNMKV Recruitment 2026?
faq.answer: The walk-in interview is on 6 November 2026, and candidates report at 9:00 AM.

faq.question: Q2. How many vacancies are there in VNMKV Recruitment 2026?
faq.answer: There are 2 vacancies: 1 Senior Research Fellow, 1 Young Professional-1.

faq.question: Q3. How do I apply for VNMKV Recruitment 2026?
faq.answer: Attend the walk-in interview on 6 November 2026 at 9:00 AM. The steps and the documents to bring are under How to Apply above.

faq.question: Q4. What is the age limit for this recruitment?
faq.answer: The maximum age is 35 years. Relaxation: SC/ST/NT/OBC As per rule.

faq.question: Q5. What is the salary for this recruitment?
faq.answer: It depends on the post: Rs. 37,000 per month + HRA for Senior Research Fellow, Rs. 30,000 Fixed per month for Young Professional-1.

faq.question: Q6. What qualification is needed for this recruitment?
faq.answer: Senior Research Fellow: M.Sc. (Agril. Entomology); Young Professional-1: B.Sc. Agriculture/ Diploma (Agri.). The requirement for each post is in the eligibility table above.

faq.question: Q7. How will candidates be selected for this recruitment?
faq.answer: Scrutiny and verification of original documents. Walk-in interview. Scrutiny and verification of original documents on 06-11-2026 at 9.00 am. Interview on the same day.

faq.question: Q8. What are the terms of engagement for this recruitment?
faq.answer: Posts filled purely on temporary basis up to 31.03.2027 or as per availability of budget in the project. Appointment on contract basis. No claim for regular appointment under VNMKV, Parbhani.

faq.answer: Chh. Sambhajinagar district.
